subject.title: Control UI: Model provider display shows original config value instead of normalized value (e.g., 'bailian' vs 'zai')

question: Should Control UI Sessions/Usage show canonical provider IDs only, or preserve configured aliases with canonical context, across display labels, filters, CSV export, and aggregate grouping?
rationale: The source-level defect is clear, but the permanent choice affects user-visible provider identity, exported data, and aggregate grouping semantics, and current origin/main's shared provider normalizer is lowercase-only.

options.title: Canonicalize derived UI/API values
options.body: Normalize only derived display, filter, query, CSV, and aggregate keys through an approved provider-id contract while leaving stored config/session values raw.

options.title: Show alias plus canonical context
options.body: Display values like canonical provider plus alias context where useful, accepting a wider UI copy and test surface.

options.title: Keep raw provider display
options.body: Document that Control UI reflects stored provider keys and accept the inconsistency with some picker/internal normalization paths.

recommendation.title: Canonicalize derived UI/API values
recommendation.body: Normalize only derived display, filter, query, CSV, and aggregate keys through an approved provider-id contract while leaving stored config/session values raw.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has recent provider/model alias resolution history and is the best available owner signal for the provider identity contract choice.
